subject: Request: short wins & micro-case for AtlasRetail one-pager
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@atlasretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short wins & micro-case for AtlasRetail one-pager

Hi Sarah —

Quick ask as Marissa and the PMM team are building a compact one-pager for Atlas Retail to include in our Q3 sales kit. We want two things we can share publicly: (1) one or two one-line value statements (one-liners / pull-quotes) and (2) a 50–100 word micro-case blurb with 1–2 key metrics you’re comfortable publishing (eg. latency reduction, cost per inference, query throughput).

Examples we aim for: 
- "Redwood cut inference costs by 42% for Atlas Retail while improving average tail latency."
- 60-word blurb with problem, solution, and outcome (metrics).

No heavy legal review needed if you’re fine with a short release; if useful, we can send a simple release form. We’ll also request a logo and a single point of contact for approvals.

Timeline: PMM hopes to lock copy by next Thursday (6/8). Could you confirm what you can share and any sensitive wording to avoid?

Appreciate it — thanks again for partnering on this.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0114

Date: Sat, 02 Jun 2028 14:03:22 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: short wins & micro-case for AtlasRetail one-pager

Hi Mina —

Thanks — happy to help. High-level things we’re comfortable publishing:

One-liner candidate (feel free to tighten): 
"With Redwood, we reduced per-query inference cost by ~42% and cut 95th-percentile latency from 620ms to 210ms in production."

Micro-case (draft, ~65 words):
Atlas Retail replaced its legacy inference service with Redwood Inference to support personalized product recommendations at scale. By adopting Redwood’s serving runtime and KV caching, Atlas Retail lowered inference costs by 42% and reduced 95th-percentile latency by ~66%, enabling faster catalog updates and improved recommendation freshness across web and mobile.

We attach our logo and a signed reference release — legal has signed the simple release you mentioned (see attachment). If you want a different phrasing or remove the precise percent, tell us.

—Sarah
Sarah Nguyen
VP, Engineering — Atlas Retail
sarah@atlasretail.com

- AtlasRetail_reference_release_signed.pdf (pdf)

Thanks Mina / Sarah (cc’ed here).

Nice — Sarah, this is exactly the kind of concise content we need. Ben, could you pull two one-liners (one bold headline & one metric-driven) and a 60–80 word micro-case from Sarah’s draft? Also: 
- Confirm the metric timeframe (what baseline period is the 42% vs. what months?)
- Ask if we can use an architecture diagram (small) or a screenshot of the dashboard, and whether we should attribute the quote to Sarah or to "Atlas Retail".

I’ll assemble a one-pager draft and send back for Atlas Retail approval before publishing. Aim: internal review by 6/7, send to Atlas Retail for final sign-off on 6/8.

(Mina: I’ll use the logo in the attachments once Ben confirms the pull-quote selection.)

Cheers,
